headline: Ethiopia's Emergency Medical Team Earns Historic WHO Classification
meta_description: Ethiopia's national Emergency Medical Team becomes first civilian EMT in WHO African Region to receive international classification after perfect assessment.

body:
Ethiopia's national Emergency Medical Team has achieved a historic milestone: it is now the first civilian EMT in the WHO African Region to receive international classification.

The team earned this distinction by scoring a perfect 96 out of 96 points against the WHO's framework for emergency medical response. This comprehensive assessment demonstrates the team's readiness and capacity to deploy during health emergencies and disasters across the region and beyond.

The achievement reflects years of training, coordination, and institutional commitment to building world-class emergency medical capabilities in Ethiopia. By meeting the highest international standards, the team sets a new benchmark for emergency preparedness in Africa and signals that quality emergency medical response is achievable across the continent.
